player_prompt.intro: Wena unguMdlali {player_id} ku-Chopsticks. Ngesikhathi sakho, khetha okukodwa kokulandelayo: + Ukuhlasela: '[attack M O]' lapho M = isandla sakho (0 noma 1), O = isandla somphikisi (0 noma 1). - Ukubalwa kwesandla somphikisi kukhuphuka ngesandla sakho; uma > = 5, kuba ngu-0. + Hlukanisa: '[split L R]' ukuze wabele kabusha iminwe yakho ephelele ku-L no-R (L + R = inani lakho). Phendula ngomunye wale miyalo.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Kumelwe ukuba i-Split iyashintsha indlela ohlukanisa ngayo izandla zakho.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Ukuhamba okungasebenzi. Sebenzisa u-[attack M O] noma u-[split L R].

game_action.attack: U-P{player_id} uhlasela isandla sika-P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: sisuka ku-{opp_val} siye ku-{new_val}.
